items.name: Bernardo Heights Sides Open 2022
items.information: ## This competition does *not* have 3x3x3 Cube - check out [Marshall Cubing September 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarshallCubingSeptember2022) or [Diamond Bar September 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DiamondBarSeptember2022) for 3x3x3 Cube instead! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BernardoHeightsSidesOpen2022#21103-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)

items.information: All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
